papers.title: Intraoperative six-axis loads during direct anterior approach total hip arthroplasty using a leg positioner: quantitative patterns across manoeuvres

llm.relevance_to_user: 该文测量全髋置换术中六轴载荷，与股骨柄应力遮挡、微动或骨-假体界面力学无直接关系。
llm.why_not_core: This study reports intraoperative surgical manoeuvre loads on a leg positioner, with no femoral stem stress shielding, micromotion, contact/friction modeling, or FE boundary conditions.

summary_zh.motivation: 量化直接前入路全髋置换术中操作杆施加的载荷模式。
summary_zh.method: 使用六轴力传感器在术中测量不同手术操作步骤的载荷。
summary_zh.result: 获得各操作步骤的六轴载荷定量分布与变化规律。
summary_zh.validation: 基于患者术中实测数据。

summary_en.motivation: To quantify the loads applied during direct anterior approach total hip arthroplasty manoeuvres performed with a leg positioner.
summary_en.method: A six-axis load sensor recorded intraoperative forces and moments across defined surgical manoeuvres.
summary_en.result: Distinct quantitative load patterns were identified for each manoeuvre during the procedure.
summary_en.validation: Intraoperative measurements were collected from patients during surgery.

papers.title: Design of white circularly polarized luminescence with high glum across entire visible regions by dual-loop active learning

llm.why_not_core: This paper addresses molecular design of circularly polarized luminescence materials via active learning, with no FEA, no surrogate modelling of solid mechanics, no implant/biomechanics context, and no uncertainty quantification for simulation.

summary_en.result: The approach yields white circularly polarized luminescence with high glum values spanning the visible spectrum.

papers.title: Disturbance Observer-based Model Predictive Control for a Twin Rotor MIMO System
papers.abstract: This paper presents a disturbance observer–based model predictive control strategy for the position regulation of a twin rotor MIMO system (TRMS). The nonlinear dynamics of the TRMS are first rewritten as an uncertain linear time invariant (LTI) system with additive disturbances. An extended state observer (ESO) is then designed to estimate both the system states and the lumped disturbance term. Using these estimates, a composite model predictive control law is formulated to achieve robust tracking performance of the desired positions of the TRMS. Simulation results demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed control scheme. AcknowledgementsThe authors thank the Ministry of Science, Humanities, Technology and Innovation (SECIHTI), Mexico, for the doctoral scholarship awarded to the first author of this paper, No. 4052738. Part of this work was carried out using AI. Microsoft Copilot was used to assist with preliminary drafting, text consistency checks, and automatic LaTeX code generation for some equations. Spanish-language metadata / Metadatos en españolTítulo en español:Control predictivo basado en modelo con observador de perturbaciones para un sistema MIMO de doble rotor Resumen:Este artículo presenta una estrategia de control predictivo basado en modelo con observador de perturbaciones para la regulación de la posición de un sistema MIMO de doble rotor (TRMS). En primer lugar, la dinámica no lineal del TRMS se reformula como un sistema lineal e invariante en el tiempo (LTI) incierto con perturbaciones aditivas. Posteriormente, se diseña un observador de estado extendido (ESO) para estimar tanto los estados del sistema como el término de perturbación agrupada. A partir de estas estimaciones, se formula una ley de control predictivo basado en modelo compuesta para lograr un seguimiento robusto de las posiciones deseadas del TRMS. Los resultados de simulación demuestran la eficacia del esquema de control propuesto. Palabras Claves:Observador de perturbaciones, control predictivo basado en modelo, sistema de doble rotor. llm.relevance_to_user: 该文属于控制理论中的MPC与扰动观测器方法，与用户关注的强化学习/世界模型及工程仿真代理建模关联很弱。
llm.why_not_core: This paper does not involve reinforcement learning, world models, surrogate modeling, or FEA-based engineering simulation; it is a classical model predictive control study on a laboratory MIMO rotor testbed.

summary_zh.motivation: 为双旋翼MIMO系统实现鲁棒位置调节。
summary_zh.method: 将非线性动力学线性化为不确定LTI系统，设计扩展状态观测器估计扰动，并构建复合MPC控制律。
summary_zh.result: 仿真表明该控制方案能有效跟踪期望位置并抑制扰动。
summary_zh.validation: 仅通过数值仿真验证，无硬件实验。

summary_en.motivation: To achieve robust position regulation for a twin rotor MIMO system subject to disturbances.
summary_en.method: The nonlinear dynamics are recast as an uncertain LTI system, an extended state observer estimates states and lumped disturbances, and a composite model predictive control law is derived.
summary_en.result: Simulation results indicate effective tracking of desired positions under the proposed scheme.
summary_en.validation: Validation is limited to numerical simulations of the TRMS without experimental hardware testing.
